tables.name: Air Genasi Naming Method
tables.description: All methods use the existing Given name + family name format. Range 1-10 core, 11-40 mortal-raised, 41-65 skyborn, 66-90 djinn lineage, 91-100 wind-names. This is a routing table, NOT a new joining rule.
